sentence: This project studies how the location and extent of a lesion affect recovery from stroke.
This project uses deep learning models to study gene expression in cell types in Alzheimer’s Disease and disease progression.
This project builds a soft robot that moves a catheter for heart surgery with six degrees of freedom.
This project studies how neighborhood contexts, Medicaid policy and hospitals affect lung cancer care and survival in low-income patients.
This project studies how pancreatic beta cells secrete insulin to maintain blood glucose levels.
This project tries to find out how fentanyl affects HIV infection with a second virus, using cell culture models and humanized mice.
This project builds human stem cell tools that make region-specific cells, circuits and tissues to help study human pain networks.
This project builds a system that gives mice radiation guided by images in a way that better matches human treatment.
This project tries to find out what causes internalizing psychiatric disorders and how genes and environment contribute to them.
This project sets up a joint program in medical physics and coursework on artificial intelligence and machine learning in cancer research.
This project uses imaging to measure inflammation in arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy and to detect and predict how the disease progresses.
This project tries to find out which nontumor cells help metastatic breast cancer tumors grow and how they do it.
This project builds deep learning methods to measure how well medical imaging systems perform realistic diagnostic tasks.
This project tests a way to track engineered T cells with imaging and treat solid tumors, including advanced ovarian cancer.
This project uses metagenomic sequencing and machine learning to quickly identify pathogens causing fungal infections and their resistance.
This project studies how molecules protect hibernating muscle from disuse atrophy.
This project tries to find out how androgen receptor signaling in T cells leads to T cell dysfunction.
This project tries to design microbial communities that stop Clostridioides difficile and E. coli infections.
This project tests nanoparticles that respond to ultrasound to destroy tumors and boost the immune response against melanoma.
This project uses machine learning to build a model that predicts cardiovascular disease risk using social determinants of health.
